schemas.name: SpeciesProfileRequest
schemas.description: Filter for the per-species profile aggregation

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileMonthly
schemas.description: Per-month sighting count (YYYY-MM bucket)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileHourly
schemas.description: Per-hour-of-day sighting count (0–23 bucket)

fields.name: hour
fields.description: 0..23 in local time of the tour

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileBucket
schemas.description: Generic histogram bucket: [min, max) plus count

fields.name: bucket_min
fields.description: inclusive lower edge of the bucket

fields.name: bucket_max
fields.description: exclusive upper edge of the bucket

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileGroupRatios
schemas.description: Share of sightings reporting juveniles / calves / newborns

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileEnv
schemas.description: Environmental preference distributions (per-bucket counts)

fields.name: depth_m
fields.description: Sea depth at sighting in meters (from SightingExtended)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfile
schemas.description: Aggregated profile of a species over a (filtered) timeframe

fields.name: period_from
fields.description: Actual date range used (resolved from request or auto-extended to data range)

fields.name: group_size_total
fields.description: Sum of species_count across all sightings

fields.name: n_unique_tours
fields.description: Number of distinct tours (tour_fid) the sightings came from. The cluster unit for pseudo-replication: sightings on one tour share boat/crew/weather and are not independent, so n_sightings alone overstates the effective sample size.

fields.name: icc
fields.description: Per-metric intraclass correlation across tours (pseudo-replication diagnostic). Empty when there are too few tours to decompose the variance.

fields.name: spatial
fields.description: KDE utilisation distribution + Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot grid. Absent when there are too few positioned sightings to estimate.

fields.name: response
fields.description: Target-group-background environmental response curves. Absent when there is no background to compare against.

fields.name: phenology
fields.description: Seasonal phenology + yearly SPUE trend (A5). Absent when no effort data.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileResponse
schemas.description: Profile response wrapper

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileCategoryShare
schemas.description: Labelled category count for donut-style charts (behaviour, reaction)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileHeadingBin
schemas.description: Heading rose bin (compass octant or finer)

fields.name: bin_deg
fields.description: Center of the bin in degrees (0 = N, 90 = E, …)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileMovement
schemas.description: Derived per-species movement signature (medians + heading rose)

fields.name: n_with_movement
fields.description: Sightings that have an associated sighting_movement row

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileHeatmapPoint
schemas.description: Sighting position for the spatial mini-heatmap

fields.name: count
fields.description: species_count at this sighting (used as weight)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileMonthlyEffort
schemas.description: Per-month tour effort + sightings + SPUE

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileYearly
schemas.description: Per-year sighting count

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileEnvExtra
schemas.description: Additional environmental distributions (salinity, SLA, currents, waves, UV)

fields.name: current_region_speed_m_s
fields.description: Histogram of the CMEMS regional-mean current speed (m/s) at sightings.

fields.name: current_coastal_component_m_s
fields.description: Histogram of the signed coastal (cross-shore) current component (m/s); negative = onshore, positive = offshore.

fields.name: wind_speed_m_s
fields.description: Histogram of the 10 m wind speed (m/s, day mean) at sightings. From WeatherService / Open-Meteo.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfilePressure
schemas.description: Anthropogenic / environmental pressure indicators at sightings

fields.name: other_boats
fields.description: Number of other boats present at sighting (parsed from other_vehicle text)

fields.name: fishing_hours_25km
fields.description: GFW fishing hours within 25 km of the sighting (day mean)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileSeismic
schemas.description: Seismic-exposure summary per species — count of correlated sightings plus magnitude/distance/offset histograms

fields.name: n_sightings_with_event
fields.description: Distinct sightings that have at least one correlated earthquake

fields.name: hours_offset
fields.description: Bucketed signed offset (positive = earthquake before sighting)

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileIcc
schemas.description: Intraclass correlation (ICC) of one metric across tours — the share of its variance that is between-tour rather than within-tour. High ICC = strong clustering by tour, so sightings are far from independent for that metric.

fields.name: icc
fields.description: Intraclass correlation, 0..1. Fraction of the metric's variance that is between-tour. Higher = stronger tour clustering (less independence).

fields.name: n_tours
fields.description: Number of tours (groups) that contributed at least one value to this metric.

fields.name: n_obs
fields.description: Number of sightings (observations) with a value for this metric.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileSpatialCell
schemas.description: One grid cell of the spatial analysis — centre lon/lat plus kernel density, utilisation-distribution isopleth level (2 = 50% core, 1 = 95% home range, 0 = outside) and Getis-Ord Gi* z-score.

fields.name: density
fields.description: Kernel probability density at the cell (surface integrates to 1).

fields.name: ud_level
fields.description: Utilisation-distribution isopleth: 2 = 50% core, 1 = 95% home range, 0 = outside.

fields.name: gi_z
fields.description: Getis-Ord Gi* z-score (|z| > 1.96 ≈ significant hot/cold spot). Null when the counts have no variance.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileSpatial
schemas.description: Server-computed spatial analysis: a regular lon/lat grid over the sightings' bounding box carrying a kernel-density utilisation distribution (50%/95% isopleths) and Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot z-scores. Only meaningful cells (inside the 95% UD or near-significant Gi*) are returned. Absent when there are too few positioned sightings.

fields.name: n_points
fields.description: Positioned sightings that fed the estimate.

fields.name: cell_lon_deg
fields.description: Cell width in degrees longitude (for drawing the cell rectangle).

fields.name: cells
fields.description: The meaningful grid cells (inside the 95% UD or near-significant Gi*).

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileResponseBin
schemas.description: One environment bin of a target-group response curve: the target species' proportion of all sightings whose environment falls in [bucket_min, bucket_max), with a Wilson 95% CI. An effort-corrected preference (background = where surveying happened).

fields.name: bucket_max
fields.description: Bin upper edge (exclusive); equal to bucket_min for the open tail bin.

fields.name: n_total
fields.description: All sightings (any species) in this bin — the background.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileEnvResponse
schemas.description: Target-group-background environmental response curves (effort-corrected preference vs raw histograms). Per covariate: the target species' proportion of all sightings per environment bin, with Wilson 95% CIs.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfilePhenologyBin
schemas.description: One month-of-year phenology bin (aggregated across all years): sightings, tour-hours and effort-corrected SPUE.

fields.name: sightings
fields.description: Sightings in this month-of-year, summed over all years.

fields.name: tour_hours
fields.description: Tour-hours of effort in this month-of-year, summed over all years.

fields.name: spue
fields.description: Sightings per tour-hour (0 when no effort that month).

schemas.name: SpeciesProfileTrendPoint
schemas.description: One year of the SPUE trend: observed effort-corrected rate, the fitted linear trend with 95% CI, and the year's mean climate indices (optional B4 overlay).

fields.name: tour_hours
fields.description: Tour-hours of effort in the year.

fields.name: fit
fields.description: Fitted linear-trend SPUE at this year.

schemas.name: SpeciesProfilePhenology
schemas.description: Phenology (12-month seasonal cycle, effort-corrected) + per-year SPUE trend with a linear fit, 95% CI band and mean climate indices.

fields.name: trend
fields.description: Per-year SPUE trend points (only years with effort).

fields.name: n
fields.description: Years used in the trend fit.
